reason: The abstract is a study protocol written entirely in future tense describing planned recruitment and assays, not completed data.
RRBS DNA methylation was measured in neonatal dried blood spots and compared between infants of normal-BMI versus obese mothers, linking methylation to a modifiable prenatal exposure.
Thirteen ESS tumors are described clinicopathologically and clustered against external reference data with no defined comparison group of the study's own design.
Methylation scores for lifestyle traits were calculated from CpGs in the Generation Scotland cohort and tested for association with major depressive disorder risk.
The study develops a puberty-aligned BMI growth reference and does not measure any epigenetic marker.
Promoter methylation of five tumor-suppressor genes was measured by MS-HRM in 73 NSCLC cases and statistically correlated with smoking status and tumor grade.
Genome-wide methylation was profiled on the EPIC array in a case-controlled comparison of pituitary adenoma patients with versus without postsurgical progression.
Methylome analysis of a national BCP-ALL registry cohort distinguished a diagnostically relevant IG-MYC-rearranged cluster with its own survival outcomes.

DNA methylation status was one of the multiomics layers profiled per patient to characterize ccRCC immunometabolism subtypes tied to immunotherapy response, though the abstract gives no methylation-specific result.
MGMT promoter methylation status from a national cancer database was tested against overall survival benefit from temozolomide in gliosarcoma.
The study measures PRDM16 mRNA/protein expression as a prognostic factor in AML, not any methylation or histone mark.
Tumor DNA was assessed for hypermethylation alongside VHL mutation per the methods, but the results section reports only mutation sharing patterns with no methylation finding stated.
PhenoAge.Accel here is computed from clinical chemistry biomarkers per the cited algorithm, not from DNA methylation data.
A randomized trial of omega-3 fatty acid immunonutrition measured TNF-alpha promoter methylation in NK cells by methylation-specific PCR.
AHRR DNA methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in a 27.8-year Japanese cohort and linked to smoking exposure and cancer mortality risk.
Cord blood DNA methylation-based gestational age deviation was tested as a mediator between prenatal air pollution/tobacco exposure and infant neurodevelopment.
The mechanistic sub-study assays sperm DNA quality using Comet, TUNEL, acridine orange, and sperm chromatin dispersion, which measure DNA strand breakage rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.

This guadecitabine trial uses a hypomethylating agent presumed to act epigenetically but the abstract reports no direct patient methylation measurement, only plasma DNA sequencing and an in vitro CRISPR screen.
Whole-blood DNAm GrimAge was measured via the EPIC array in a case-control comparison of hypersexual disorder patients and healthy volunteers to test epigenetic aging as a risk marker.
The epigenetic clock GrimAge was derived from blood in a cross-sectional cohort and shown to mediate the association of vitamin D status with knee pain.
This cluster RCT concerns nurse facilitation for vital-sign escalation and involves no epigenetic marker whatsoever.
Genome-wide DNA methylation was profiled in a nested case-control design to find CpG biomarkers discriminating active tuberculosis from latent infection.
Five DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks were compared cross-sectionally and longitudinally against Alzheimer's-related hippocampal volume and amyloid PET in two aging cohorts.
The UK Biobank analysis measures leucocyte telomere length, which is not one of the eligible epigenetic marker categories.
DNA global methylation profiling distinguished chordoid from non-chordoid meningiomas and correlated with progression-free survival differences (p=0.019).
MLH1 promoter methylation testing was part of a prospective universal screening algorithm for Lynch syndrome in endometrial cancer patients.
EPIC-chip DNA methylation risk scores were calculated in children of the LISA cohort and tested for their ability to classify and predict aeroallergen sensitization.
Methylation subtypes derived from TCGA, FH, and ICGC prostate tumor methylomes were validated as prognostic for biochemical recurrence and metastasis across three cohorts.
Serum MECP2 protein was quantified by ELISA as a prognostic marker in hip-fracture patients; this measures the protein, not DNA methylation itself.

METTL1's role concerns RNA m7G modification and its expression/activity across pan-cancer datasets; methylation data appear only as an input to a stemness index, not as a directly reported epigenetic finding.
RAP1GAP CpG methylation was quantified by MSP in a case-control comparison of medullary thyroid cancer, benign nodules, and normal thyroid tissue.
This study quantifies nuclear morphometry and chromatin texture by image analysis of stained slides, not a molecular epigenetic mark.
An epigenome-wide association study using 850K arrays tracked DNA methylation over six years across groups with differing hyperglycaemia exposure in the D.E.S.I.R. cohort.
KDM-biological age and PhenoAge in this UK Biobank analysis are explicitly derived from clinical trait algorithms, not from DNA methylation.
MGMT promoter methylation was assessed by methylation-specific PCR alongside histone-mutation status in this comparison of adult and pediatric diffuse midline glioma outcomes.
TXNIP DNA methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in leukocytes and compared across non-, moderate, and heavy drinkers in a Japanese cross-sectional study.
TLR9 promoter and intragenic CpG methylation was bisulfite-sequenced and compared between inflamed periapical lesions and healthy periodontal ligament tissue.
The abstract describes targeted bisulfite sequencing of plasma ccfDNA for candidate Alzheimer's markers but does not state the study design, sample size, or comparison groups used.
Loss of sex chromosome is a cytogenetic abnormality, not an epigenetic marker, in this AML prognostic study.

Bisulphite amplicon sequencing of ten neurodevelopmental loci was used to test whether offspring DNA methylation mediates the link between maternal tobacco use in pregnancy and childhood conduct problems.
DCR1 methylation status was assessed in tumor DNA from patients randomized to adjuvant chemotherapy arms in the CALGB 89803 trial to test its predictive value for irinotecan benefit.
This HERBY trial sub-analysis classifies tumors by H3 K27 mutation and EGFR status via imaging and sequencing, with no methylation assay reported.

DNA methylation status of CCNA2 was assessed using multi-database patient data as part of a pan-cancer prognostic and drug-sensitivity characterization, though no methylation-specific result is stated.

This retrospective LCNEC series relies on clinical imaging, immunohistochemistry, and mutation profiling, with chromatin pattern noted only as a light-microscopy morphology feature rather than a molecular assay.
MGMT promoter methylation percentage was measured by pyrosequencing and correlated with MRI-based volumetric treatment response in glioblastoma patients.
Machine-learning-derived DNA methylation signatures (EpiSig10/13/14) from TCGA breast cancer patients were validated to predict pathologic nodal stage and could guide axillary surgery decisions.
ChIP here is used to demonstrate ATF1 transcription-factor binding at the MMP2 promoter, not to measure a histone modification or chromatin state.
Leukocyte LINE-1 DNA methylation was measured in a cross-sectional Japanese cohort and associated with muscle loss and frailty risk in older men.
Biological age here is derived from a deep neural network trained on 36 blood biomarkers, not from DNA methylation.
PEAR1 promoter methylation at 16 CpG sites was measured in blood from a family-based cohort followed 18 years for incident colorectal cancer.
This study characterizes ATRX gene mutations (nonsense, missense, multiexon deletions) in neuroblastoma, a genetic rather than epigenetic alteration.
Targeted bisulfite sequencing DNA methylation profiles were used to infer tissue-of-origin for cancer-of-unknown-primary patients, a diagnostic application.
DNA methylation patterns, including MGMT promoter status, defined two myxopapillary ependymoma subtypes with significantly different relapse rates over ten years.
A blood epigenome-wide association study in postmenopausal women measured DNA methylation loci associated with urinary glyphosate and AMPA exposure.
DNA methylation array data were integrated with RNA expression in a case-control comparison of follicular thyroid carcinoma and benign lesions to derive a diagnostic CpG marker.

The genome-wide CRISPR screen and HDAC-inhibitor sensitization experiments identify NOXA loss as a resistance mechanism to CAR T-cell therapy without directly measuring histone acetylation in patients.
Single-cell DNA methylation and chromatin accessibility were profiled in B cells from a CVID-discordant twin pair and validated in a cohort of CVID patients versus healthy donors.

This 14-person tissue-comparison study relates epigenetic clocks across blood and brain regions to microglial burden as a biological mechanism, without testing a modifiable exposure or a stated clinical decision.
Retrospective DNA methylation analysis was performed on tumor samples from a pilot trial adding genomic-guided targeted agents and DFMO to high-risk neuroblastoma therapy.
The H4K20me1 histone-mark ChIP experiments were performed in a cultured human glomerular endothelial cell line rather than in the diabetic-nephropathy patients' own tissue.
H3K27me3 loss was assessed by immunohistochemistry in 200 ependymomas and correlated with progression-free and overall survival in the posterior-fossa subgroup.
Public GEO methylation data were correlated with gene expression to identify hub genes with high diagnostic ROC value for pediatric pilocytic astrocytoma.
An epigenome-wide association study tested whether grandmaternal smoking during pregnancy is associated with differential DNA methylation in cord blood and adolescent blood of grandchildren.

SNCA promoter methylation was shown to correlate inversely with mRNA expression across bladder cancer databases and was confirmed by demethylating agent treatment of cell lines, in a prognostic biomarker study.
Specific CpG methylation differences (GZMB, KRT80, MT1G, CLEC12B, NDUFA7) between lung adenocarcinoma grades were identified using TCGA methylation data.
Adipocyte CpG methylation was profiled by EPIC BeadChip before and up to 10 years after bariatric surgery, an intervention, in women who partially regained weight.
Cord and childhood blood DNA methylation was measured longitudinally and linked to gestational cadmium exposure in a Bangladeshi mother-child cohort.
WNT5A promoter CpG methylation was measured in 59 CLL patient samples and used to define prognostic subgroups predicting treatment-free survival.
This vaccine safety cohort study concerns a CpG adjuvant used to boost hepatitis B vaccine immunogenicity, not any epigenetic marker measurement.
H3K27ac and H3K4me3 histone modification landscapes were profiled in postmortem prefrontal cortex from 739 individuals with and without schizophrenia or bipolar disorder.
DNA methylation was profiled by EPIC array in firefighter recruits before and after starting service and linked to cumulative occupational fire exposure.
Horvath-clock DNA methylation age acceleration was computed from 450k methylomes across four glioblastoma clinical-trial cohorts and linked to treatment outcome.
CpG methylation of the CYP3A4 upstream region was compared between 11 paired human gastric cancer and adjacent healthy tissue samples alongside an in vitro diazinon exposure experiment.
Cord blood DNA methylation was profiled by EPIC array in a Korean birth cohort and linked to prenatal PM10 and NO2 exposure.
Whole-genome DNA methylation and histone-acetylation marks were profiled in PBMCs from participants of the BCN02 HIV kick-and-kill trial and were predictive of subsequent viral rebound.
Blood and synovial fluid monocyte DNA methylation profiles were compared prospectively across early inflammatory arthritis patients grouped by future good versus poor outcome.
A digital droplet PCR assay detecting hypermethylated ZSCAN12/OXT circulating tumor DNA was validated in plasma from endometrial carcinoma patients versus cancer-free controls.
ORMDL3 promoter methylation across nine CpG sites was measured by MS-HRM in a case-control comparison of children with and without allergic asthma.
SUMF2, ADAMTS5, and PXDN methylation levels were quantified by MS-PCR/EpiTYPER in tumor and adjacent tissue from a Taiwanese colorectal cancer cohort and tested against survival outcomes.
This glioblastoma trial adds the HDAC inhibitor belinostat to chemoradiation based on its presumed epigenetic mechanism, but no histone acetylation status was measured in patients.
The FRIGHT and AFRAID clocks are tested exclusively in C57BL/6J mice undergoing polypharmacy and deprescribing, with no human participants.
Methylation at the AIM2 gene locus cg10636246 was tested as a mediator between PTSD symptom severity and inflammatory/neuropathology plasma markers in post-9/11 veterans.
A targeted DNA methylation method estimating immune cell composition from blood was used to predict pneumonia diagnosis and severity, including COVID-19 status.
This HELIX project analysis catalogues methylation-expression correlations (eQTMs) in children's blood as a methodological resource, without testing any specific exposure or clinical decision.
This LUAD study characterizes mutations and expression repression of SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling subunits, not a directly measured methylation or histone-modification mark.
This UK Biobank study measures leucocyte telomere length by qPCR, which falls outside the eligible epigenetic marker categories.
MethylationEPIC BeadChip profiling of samples from the randomized TAVAREC glioma trial identified DNA methylation classes prognostic for time to progression at recurrence.
MGMT gene promoter methylation status was assessed across molecular subgroups of 93 lower-grade gliomas and tested for association with oligodendroglial histology and outcome.
Blood DNA methylation at BDNF Exon IV was measured in adolescent boys and tested against urinary metabolites of non-persistent pesticide exposures and behavioral outcomes.
SMARCA2 protein loss was detected by immunohistochemistry on tissue microarrays, which measures protein expression rather than chromatin state or a histone mark.
Chromatin-immunoprecipitation here demonstrates ZEB1 transcription-factor binding at chemokine gene promoters, not a histone modification or chromatin-state mark.

This NHANES cross-sectional study measures serum klotho protein by ELISA against urinary PAH metabolites, with no DNA methylation assay performed despite background discussion of methylation and aging.
Seven DNA methylation sites were among the blood markers measured in a case-control comparison of endometrial cancer, breast cancer, benign lesion, and control groups to build a diagnostic panel.
HMGA1 mRNA and protein expression were measured by qRT-PCR and immunohistochemistry as a diagnostic marker in neuroendocrine tumors, not the chromatin state itself.
DNA methylation status of SNRPA1 was assessed via multi-database patient data as part of a prognostic and drug-sensitivity characterization in ccRCC, though no methylation-specific finding is stated.
Genome-wide DNA methylation and five epigenetic clocks were measured in leukocytes of a Costa Rican longevity cohort and compared between current, former, and never smokers.
HDAC7 protein expression was assessed by immunohistochemistry as a prognostic marker in NSCLC, not the histone acetylation mark it catalyzes.

Citrullinated histone H3 (H3cit) was measured in serum as a NET marker of thrombosis risk in atrial fibrillation, which the instrument treats as a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
MGMT promoter methylation status was determined by sequencing and methylation profiling in the randomized phase III CATNON trial and tested for predictive value for temozolomide benefit.
This CLSA cohort profile reports genome-wide SNP genotyping data only; DNA methylation is named solely as a future data collection plan, not yet measured.
